title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-alex-morris-avery-chen-2026-03-05
content:
Purpose: quick sync with Alex (AE) to align on top accounts, handoffs, and any open blockers before EOW. Keep to 30m.

Meeting logistics:
- When: 2026-03-05 10:00am PT (30m)
- Where: Zoom / slack link in calendar

High-level goals:
1) Review status of top 3 joint accounts and next milestones (Nimbus Analytics, Orion Health, LumaRetail).
2) Confirm handoff plan for Orion pilot -> Dedicated trial (timing, stakeholders, success criteria).
3) Surface any escalations (latency concerns, pricing pushback) and agree on action owners.
4) Align on AE ask list for CS (intro emails, exec sponsor intro, technical contact).

Agenda (30m):
- 0-5m: quick personal check-in + calendar conflicts
- 5-15m: account status updates (one slide or 1-2 bullets each)
- 15-22m: Orion Dedicated pilot readiness + blockers
- 22-28m: escalations, pricing asks, docs needed
- 28-30m: confirm action items and deadlines

Talking points / prompts for Alex:
- Nimbus Analytics: last I saw they have throughput spike concerns for end-of-month reports. Are they on the batching/kv-cache recommendations we proposed? Do we need to provide a short config playbook or offer a spike w/ dedicated pool?
- Orion Health: demo went well; exec sponsor asked for latency SLOs and SOC2 evidence. Do we have a firm timeline for Dedicated onboarding? Who is their infra lead?
- LumaRetail: still evaluating embeddings; they're sensitive to per-embedding cost. Can you re-open pricing conversation or propose Optimize run?

Customer-specific notes (quick bullets):
- Nimbus Analytics (POC): wants 99th percentile under 300ms for 2k qps sample. Currently hitting ~420ms in staging with current config. Possible causes: model variant selection + short-context inefficiencies. Ask infra/RTO for a profiling session.
- Orion Health (HIPAA): legal asking for private deployment docs and KMS options. Need security checklist + SOC2 report. Also need to map gating stakeholders (CISO, infra manager, product).
- LumaRetail (SaaS): exploring embeddings for product search. Cost sensitivity: want cost per query estimate for 10M monthly queries. Might be good candidate for Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching).

Open risks / escalations:
- Latency regression on Nimbus in staging (perf profile needed). If we can’t show improvement by next week, they may delay pilot -> track as high risk.
- Orion legal turnaround time unknown; coordinate with Solutions Eng to prepare Private deployment brief.
- LumaRetail pricing discussions could stall if we don’t present Optimize ROI case by EOW.

Requests to Alex (explicit asks):
- Introductions: please intro me to Orion infra lead (name + email) -- I will own the technical onboarding checklist. Due: 2026-03-08.
- Executive sponsor: confirm availability for a 20m exec intro for Orion (target next Wed). Due: 2026-03-10.
- Customer-facing docs: push Nimbus for logs/access to reproduce latency; ask them to allow a 2-hr profiling window. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Pricing: for LumaRetail, can you re-open pricing and ask if they’d consider a 3-month pilot with committed spend? I’ll prepare Optimize ROI deck if they say yes. Due: 2026-03-09.

My asks / what I’ll bring:
- I’ll draft the Orion Private deployment checklist + SOC2 pack and share by EOD 3/6.
- I’ll coordinate with SE (Samira) for a short profiling run for Nimbus and book calendar.
- I’ll prepare a 1-page Optimize ROI snapshot for LumaRetail if Alex confirms pilot interest.

Proposed action items (to capture in CRM / Asana):
- ACTION: Avery -> create Orion Private onboarding checklist + attach SOC2 (due 2026-03-06).
- ACTION: Alex -> intro to Orion infra lead + exec sponsor availability (due 2026-03-08 / 03-10).
- ACTION: Avery -> schedule profiling window with SEs for Nimbus and gather staging logs (due 2026-03-06).
- ACTION: Alex -> re-open pricing conversation with LumaRetail and confirm pilot interest (due 2026-03-09).
- ACTION: Samira (SE) -> allocate 2h profiling slot and run perf capture for Nimbus (target 2026-03-06).

Notes to self (prep before meeting):
- Bring latency numbers (p50/p95/p99) for Nimbus staging and prod if available.
- Quick bullets on what Optimize does (batching, quantization, cost delta examples).
- Link to SOC2 + Private deployment template in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-1234).

Follow-up plan after 1:1:
- Send a 1-paragraph recap to Alex + copy in Samira and Orion contacts with agreed action owners and due dates.
- Create Asana tickets for each ACTION with owners and link back to this doc.
- Check in mid-week with Alex on Orion legal progress.

Misc / parking lot items (if time):
- Quick health-check on renewal accounts next quarter (flag accounts with >70% utilization).
- Discuss whether to push a webinar about Optimize case studies for retail vertical.

End of notes.

Quick links referenced:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234 (Private deploy checklist)
- Jira: JIRA-CS-987 (Nimbus latency investigation)
- Slack: #acct-team thread (link in calendar invite)
